Instructions:
Instrctions:

Locate the column corresponding to your language. You should have editing access only to that column, with all other columns being read-only.

Do not translate anything that is in square brackets: [ ]
Examples: [dmg] , [time] , [NEWLINE] This is used to display icons.

[NEWLINE] is a tag for defining newline (seen only in app)

Do not remove styling tags such as: <b>, <i>, <color=...>, or <sprite=...>.
Examples: <b> bold </b> <i> italic </i>

After confirming an entry in the Comments section, a script runs that compares tags against the original.
If tag errors are found, fix them. Sometimes it happens that the comparison script doesn't run,
 re-editing the entry will trigger the comparison script again.

At the bottom are UI translations, don't forget about them.
If you want to see and check on app read this:Dragon Eclipse Test App Guide

ENTRY_A0_[1]_CAERBERG___C205
Caerberg – you’ve always loved this city, perched atop a barren hill from which you can admire a scenic vista of old forest, winding merchant roads, and low rocky hills. Your gaze finds the wind turbines connected to the water pumps and forges. Their noise grates, but they fill you with pride anyway.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You are one of the few people responsible for ensuring all this works properly. Unlike a clever Duchess who rules over people and laws, and engineers who supervise the steel and brass, tamers like you train and care for the mystlings that support the whole structure.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]But sometimes, you feel suffocated in the city. You often wander through the surrounding forests, but that doesn’t satisfy your thirst for something more. Sometimes, you want to take your mystling and see the world. But you can’t. You are the head tamer of Caerberg. The people need you.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You check on the Windraiser, a timid mystling possessing tremendous power who controls the airflow through windmills and turbines. It utters a pleasant sound when it sees you. Tomorrow, you will train it and several other creatures. But today, you both have work to do.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]For some time, you show the Windraiser how to use its powers more efficiently (and give the mystling a little treat). Soon, the turbines spin a little faster as the wind flowing through the city accelerates.

In consequence, they were forcefully exiled from our world into the world on the other side of the portals – the Shadow Realm. However, deciding whether the Dragon Guardians made the right choice is impossible right now. Nothing indicates that the fae did it on purpose.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]You have not encountered a single piece of information about a Dragon Guardian of the Dark. It seems that there are only five of them, one for each element except darkness. Their presence is crucial for the balance of the elements, thus for nature to function properly.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The darkness element doesn’t seem to be native to the world. It fits well, being a counterweight for the light, although there is no evidence it existed outside the Shadow Realm before the first Eclipse. Contemporary scholars agree that the world couldn’t function correctly without all six elements.</i>

The Dragon Guardians deemed the fae guilty of trying to destroy the world. And they protected it, trying not to shed blood – by exiling the fae into the unknown place through the portals the fae opened.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]If only they had spoken to one another.
